_comment: Seed data only — scripts/seed-content.js copies this into the `content` table on first run. After that, edit the Bushfire Danger Period dates from the members' area (/admin), not this file. Bungendore sits in the NSW RFS 'Southern Ranges' district; the dates below are the statewide statutory default (1 Oct - 31 Mar). The RFS Commissioner can vary these per district in a given year — check the authoritative table at https://www.rfs.nsw.gov.au/fire-information/BFDP before confirming.
